reviewer.builder_relation: independent; did not author or modify the reviewed implementation

criteria: visual hierarchy makes the subject and primary purpose legible
flow, status table and ownership boundary remain readable at the reviewed export size
HTML, PNG and PDF are materially equivalent derived views
PNG crop has no material blank tail
visual evidence does not claim semantic correctness or reader success

readback.png: inspected 1440x1120 export; content ends after the source-and-boundary section with no material blank tail
readback.pdf: rendered and inspected both Letter pages at 144 dpi; all content is legible and follows the HTML order

evidence: The hero, three summary cards, process flow and five-gate matrix establish a clear visual hierarchy for the stated system sample.
The reviewed PNG preserves the full content and has no material empty lower canvas after the corrected content crop.
The PDF retains the same hierarchy and content across two pages; its second page contains normal unused lower-page space after the final boundary paragraph.
The sample labels local evidence and unproven gates rather than visually presenting them as completed outcomes.

cannot_promote: This review does not certify semantic correctness, source completeness, public reachability, reader utility, owner-state closure or accessibility conformance beyond visible legibility.
The PDF page-two unused lower space must not be interpreted as a PNG crop failure or as a reader-task success signal.
limits: Review was performed on one desktop-scale PNG and a two-page Letter PDF; no assistive-technology, mobile-device or real-reader-task evaluation was performed.
